## Metrics

| Name | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_Query` | counter | Number | Number of queries to be interpreted and potentially executed. Does not include queries that failed to parse or were rejected due to AST size limits, quota limits or limits on the number of simultaneously running queries. May include internal queries initiated by ClickHouse itself. Does not count subqueries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_SelectQuery` | counter | Number | Same as Query, but only for SELECT queries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_InsertQuery` | counter | Number | Same as Query, but only for INSERT queries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_QueriesWithSubqueries` | counter | Number | Count queries with all subqueries |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_SelectQueriesWithSubqueries` | counter | Number | Count SELECT queries with all subqueries |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_InsertQueriesWithSubqueries` | counter | Number | Count INSERT queries with all subqueries |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_AsyncInsertQuery` | counter | Number | Same as InsertQuery, but only for asynchronous INSERT queries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_AsyncInsertBytes` | counter | Bytes | Data size in bytes of asynchronous INSERT queries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_AsyncInsertRows` | counter | Number | Number of rows inserted by asynchronous INSERT queries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_AsyncInsertCacheHits` | counter | Number | Number of times a duplicate hash id has been found in asynchronous INSERT hash id cache. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_FailedQuery` | counter | Number | Number of failed queries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_FailedSelectQuery` | counter | Number | Same as FailedQuery, but only for SELECT queries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_FailedInsertQuery` | counter | Number | Same as FailedQuery, but only for INSERT queries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_FailedAsyncInsertQuery` | counter | Number | Number of failed ASYNC INSERT queries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_QueryTimeMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time of all queries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_SelectQueryTimeMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time of SELECT queries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_InsertQueryTimeMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time of INSERT queries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_OtherQueryTimeMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time of queries that are not SELECT or INSERT. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_FileOpen` | counter | Number | Number of files opened. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_Seek` | counter | Number | Number of times the 'lseek' function was called. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ReadBufferFromFileDescriptorRead` | counter | Number | Number of reads (read/pread) from a file descriptor. Does not include sockets. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ReadBufferFromFileDescriptorReadFailed` | counter | Number | Number of times the read (read/pread) from a file descriptor have failed. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ReadBufferFromFileDescriptorReadBytes` | counter | Number | Number of bytes read from file descriptors. If the file is compressed, this will show the compressed data size. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_WriteBufferFromFileDescriptorWrite` | counter | Number | Number of writes (write/pwrite) to a file descriptor. Does not include sockets. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_WriteBufferFromFileDescriptorWriteFailed` | counter | Number | Number of times the write (write/pwrite) to a file descriptor have failed. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_WriteBufferFromFileDescriptorWriteBytes` | counter | Number | Number of bytes written to file descriptors. If the file is compressed, this will show compressed data size. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_FileSync` | counter | Number | Number of times the F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/fdatasync function was called for files. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DirectorySync` | counter | Number | Number of times the F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/fdatasync function was called for directories. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_FileSyncElapsedMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time spent waiting for F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/fdatasync syscall for files. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DirectorySyncElapsedMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time spent waiting for F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/fdatasync syscall for directories. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ReadCompressedBytes` | counter | Number | Number of bytes (the number of bytes before decompression) read from compressed sources (files, network). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_CompressedReadBufferBlocks` | counter | Number | Number of compressed blocks (the blocks of data that are compressed independent of each other) read from compressed sources (files, network). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_CompressedReadBufferBytes` | counter | Number | Number of uncompressed bytes (the number of bytes after decompression) read from compressed sources (files, network). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_UncompressedCacheHits` | counter | Number | Number of times a block of data has been found in the uncompressed cache (and decompression was avoided). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_UncompressedCacheMisses` | counter | Number | Number of times a block of data has not been found in the uncompressed cache (and required decompression). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_UncompressedCacheWeightLost` | counter | Number | Number of bytes evicted from the uncompressed cache. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_MMappedFileCacheHits` | counter | Number | Number of times a file has been found in the MMap cache (for the 'mmap' read_method), so we didn't have to mmap it again. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_MMappedFileCacheMisses` | counter | Number | Number of times a file has not been found in the MMap cache (for the 'mmap' read_method), so we had to mmap it again. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_OpenedFileCacheHits` | counter | Number | Number of times a file has been found in the opened file cache, so we didn't have to open it again. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_OpenedFileCacheMisses` | counter | Number | Number of times a file has been found in the opened file cache, so we had to open it again. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_OpenedFileCacheMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Amount of time spent executing OpenedFileCache methods. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_AIOWrite` | counter | Number | Number of writes with Linux or FreeBSD AIO interface |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_AIOWriteBytes` | counter | Number | Number of bytes written with Linux or FreeBSD AIO interface |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_AIORead` | counter | Number | Number of reads with Linux or FreeBSD AIO interface |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_AIOReadBytes` | counter | Number | Number of bytes read with Linux or FreeBSD AIO interface |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_IOBufferAllocs` | counter | Number | Number of allocations of IO buffers (for ReadBuffer/WriteBuffer). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_IOBufferAllocBytes` | counter | Number | Number of bytes allocated for IO buffers (for ReadBuffer/WriteBuffer). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ArenaAllocChunks` | counter | Number | Number of chunks allocated for memory Arena (used for GROUP BY and similar operations) |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ArenaAllocBytes` | counter | Number | Number of bytes allocated for memory Arena (used for GROUP BY and similar operations) |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_FunctionExecute` | counter | Number | Number of SQL ordinary function calls (SQL functions are called on per-block basis, so this number represents the number of blocks). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_TableFunctionExecute` | counter | Number | Number of table function calls. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_MarkCacheHits` | counter | Number | Number of times an entry has been found in the mark cache, so we didn't have to load a mark file. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_MarkCacheMisses` | counter | Number | Number of times an entry has not been found in the mark cache, so we had to load a mark file in memory, which is a costly operation, adding to query latency. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_QueryCacheHits` | counter | Number | Number of times a query result has been found in the query cache (and query computation was avoided). Only updated for SELECT queries with SETTING use_query_cache = 1. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_QueryCacheMisses` | counter | Number | Number of times a query result has not been found in the query cache (and required query computation). Only updated for SELECT queries with SETTING use_query_cache = 1. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_CreatedReadBufferOrdinary` | counter | Number | Number of times ordinary read buffer was created for reading data (while choosing among other read methods). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_CreatedReadBufferDirectIO` | counter | Number | Number of times a read buffer with O_DIRECT was created for reading data (while choosing among other read methods). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_CreatedReadBufferDirectIOFailed` | counter | Number | Number of times a read buffer with O_DIRECT was attempted to be created for reading data (while choosing among other read methods), but the OS did not allow it (due to lack of filesystem support or other reasons) and we fallen back to the ordinary reading method. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_CreatedReadBufferMMap` | counter | Number | Number of times a read buffer using 'mmap' was created for reading data (while choosing among other read methods). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_CreatedReadBufferMMapFailed` | counter | Number | Number of times a read buffer with 'mmap' was attempted to be created for reading data (while choosing among other read methods), but the OS did not allow it (due to lack of filesystem support or other reasons) and we fallen back to the ordinary reading method. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DiskReadElapsedMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time spent waiting for read syscall. This include reads from page cache. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DiskWriteElapsedMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time spent waiting for write syscall. This include writes to page cache. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_NetworkReceiveElapsedMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time spent waiting for data to receive or receiving data from network. Only ClickHouse-related network interaction is included, not by 3rd party libraries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_NetworkSendElapsedMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time spent waiting for data to send to network or sending data to network. Only ClickHouse-related network interaction is included, not by 3rd party libraries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_NetworkReceiveBytes` | counter | Number | Total number of bytes received from network. Only ClickHouse-related network interaction is included, not by 3rd party libraries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_NetworkSendBytes` | counter | Number | Total number of bytes send to network. Only ClickHouse-related network interaction is included, not by 3rd party libraries. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DiskS3GetRequestThrottlerCount` | counter | Number | Number of DiskS3 GET and SELECT requests passed through throttler. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DiskS3GetRequestThrottlerSleepMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time a query was sleeping to conform DiskS3 GET and SELECT request throttling. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DiskS3PutRequestThrottlerCount` | counter | Number | Number of DiskS3 PUT, COPY, POST and LIST requests passed through throttler. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DiskS3PutRequestThrottlerSleepMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time a query was sleeping to conform DiskS3 PUT, COPY, POST and LIST request throttling. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_S3GetRequestThrottlerCount` | counter | Number | Number of S3 GET and SELECT requests passed through throttler. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_S3GetRequestThrottlerSleepMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time a query was sleeping to conform S3 GET and SELECT request throttling. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_S3PutRequestThrottlerCount` | counter | Number | Number of S3 PUT, COPY, POST and LIST requests passed through throttler. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_S3PutRequestThrottlerSleepMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time a query was sleeping to conform S3 PUT, COPY, POST and LIST request throttling. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_RemoteReadThrottlerBytes` | counter | Bytes | Bytes passed through 'max_remote_read_network_bandwidth_for_server'/'max_remote_read_network_bandwidth' throttler. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_RemoteReadThrottlerSleepMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time a query was sleeping to conform 'max_remote_read_network_bandwidth_for_server'/'max_remote_read_network_bandwidth' throttling. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_RemoteWriteThrottlerBytes` | counter | Bytes | Bytes passed through 'max_remote_write_network_bandwidth_for_server'/'max_remote_write_network_bandwidth' throttler. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_RemoteWriteThrottlerSleepMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time a query was sleeping to conform 'max_remote_write_network_bandwidth_for_server'/'max_remote_write_network_bandwidth' throttling. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_LocalReadThrottlerBytes` | counter | Bytes | Bytes passed through 'max_local_read_bandwidth_for_server'/'max_local_read_bandwidth' throttler. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_LocalReadThrottlerSleepMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time a query was sleeping to conform 'max_local_read_bandwidth_for_server'/'max_local_read_bandwidth' throttling. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_LocalWriteThrottlerBytes` | counter | Bytes | Bytes passed through 'max_local_write_bandwidth_for_server'/'max_local_write_bandwidth' throttler. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_LocalWriteThrottlerSleepMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time a query was sleeping to conform 'max_local_write_bandwidth_for_server'/'max_local_write_bandwidth' throttling. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ThrottlerSleepMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time a query was sleeping to conform all throttling settings. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_QueryMaskingRulesMatch` | counter | Number | Number of times query masking rules was successfully matched. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ReplicatedPartFetches` | counter | Number | Number of times a data part was downloaded from replica of a ReplicatedMergeTree table. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ReplicatedPartFailedFetches` | counter | Number | Number of times a data part was failed to download from replica of a ReplicatedMergeTree table. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ObsoleteReplicatedParts` | counter | Number | Number of times a data part was covered by another data part that has been fetched from a replica (so, we have marked a covered data part as obsolete and no longer needed). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ReplicatedPartMerges` | counter | Number | Number of times data parts of ReplicatedMergeTree tables were successfully merged. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ReplicatedPartFetchesOfMerged` | counter | Number | Number of times we prefer to download already merged part from replica of ReplicatedMergeTree table instead of performing a merge ourself (usually we prefer doing a merge ourself to save network traffic). This happens when we have not all source parts to perform a merge or when the data part is old enough. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ReplicatedPartMutations` | counter | Number | Number of times data parts of ReplicatedMergeTree tables were successfully mutated. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ReplicatedPartChecks` | counter | Number | Number of times we had to perform advanced search for a data part on replicas or to clarify the need of an existing data part. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ReplicatedPartChecksFailed` | counter | Number | Number of times the advanced search for a data part on replicas did not give result or when unexpected part has been found and moved away. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ReplicatedDataLoss` | counter | Number | Number of times a data part that we wanted doesn't exist on any replica (even on replicas that are offline right now). That data parts are definitely lost. This is normal due to asynchronous replication (if quorum inserts were not enabled), when the replica on which the data part was written was failed and when it became online after fail it doesn't contain that data part. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ReplicatedCoveredPartsInZooKeeperOnStart` | counter | Number | For debugging purposes. Number of parts in ZooKeeper that have a covering part, but doesn't exist on disk. Checked on server start. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_InsertedRows` | counter | Number | Number of rows INSERTed to all tables. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_InsertedBytes` | counter | Number | Number of bytes (uncompressed; for columns as they stored in memory) INSERTed to all tables. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DelayedInserts` | counter | Number | Number of times the INSERT of a block to a MergeTree table was throttled due to high number of active data parts for partition. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_RejectedInserts` | counter | Number | Number of times the INSERT of a block to a MergeTree table was rejected with 'Too many parts' exception due to high number of active data parts for partition. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DelayedInsertsMilliseconds` | counter | Milliseconds | Total number of milliseconds spent while the INSERT of a block to a MergeTree table was throttled due to high number of active data parts for partition. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DelayedMutations` | counter | Number | Number of times the mutation of a MergeTree table was throttled due to high number of unfinished mutations for table. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_RejectedMutations` | counter | Number | Number of times the mutation of a MergeTree table was rejected with 'Too many mutations' exception due to high number of unfinished mutations for table. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DelayedMutationsMilliseconds` | counter | Milliseconds | Total number of milliseconds spent while the mutation of a MergeTree table was throttled due to high number of unfinished mutations for table. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DistributedDelayedInserts` | counter | Number | Number of times the INSERT of a block to a Distributed table was throttled due to high number of pending bytes. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DistributedRejectedInserts` | counter | Number | Number of times the INSERT of a block to a Distributed table was rejected with 'Too many bytes' exception due to high number of pending bytes. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DistributedDelayedInsertsMilliseconds` | counter | Milliseconds | Total number of milliseconds spent while the INSERT of a block to a Distributed table was throttled due to high number of pending bytes. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DuplicatedInsertedBlocks` | counter | Number | Number of times the INSERTed block to a ReplicatedMergeTree table was deduplicated. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperInit` | counter | Number | Number of times connection with ZooKeeper has been established. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperTransactions` | counter | Number | Number of ZooKeeper operations, which include both read and write operations as well as multi-transactions. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperList` | counter | Number | Number of 'list' (getChildren) requests to ZooKeeper. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperCreate` | counter | Number | Number of 'create' requests to ZooKeeper. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperRemove` | counter | Number | Number of 'remove' requests to ZooKeeper. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperExists` | counter | Number | Number of 'exists' requests to ZooKeeper. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperGet` | counter | Number | Number of 'get' requests to ZooKeeper. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperSet` | counter | Number | Number of 'set' requests to ZooKeeper. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperMulti` | counter | Number | Number of 'multi' requests to ZooKeeper (compound transactions). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperCheck` | counter | Number | Number of 'check' requests to ZooKeeper. Usually they don't make sense in isolation, only as part of a complex transaction. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperSync` | counter | Number | Number of 'sync' requests to ZooKeeper. These requests are rarely needed or usable. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperReconfig` | counter | Number | Number of 'reconfig' requests to ZooKeeper. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperClose` | counter | Number | Number of times connection with ZooKeeper has been closed voluntary. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperWatchResponse` | counter | Number | Number of times watch notification has been received from ZooKeeper. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperUserExceptions` | counter | Number | Number of exceptions while working with ZooKeeper related to the data (no node, bad version or similar). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperHardwareExceptions` | counter | Number | Number of exceptions while working with ZooKeeper related to network (connection loss or similar). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperOtherExceptions` | counter | Number | Number of exceptions while working with ZooKeeper other than ZooKeeperUserExceptions and ZooKeeperHardwareExceptions. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperWaitMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Number of microseconds spent waiting for responses from ZooKeeper after creating a request, summed across all the requesting threads. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperBytesSent` | counter | Number | Number of bytes send over network while communicating with ZooKeeper. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ZooKeeperBytesReceived` | counter | Number | Number of bytes received over network while communicating with ZooKeeper. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DistributedConnectionTries` | counter | Number | Total count of distributed connection attempts. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DistributedConnectionUsable` | counter | Number | Total count of successful distributed connections to a usable server (with required table, but maybe stale). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DistributedConnectionFailTry` | counter | Number | Total count when distributed connection fails with retry. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DistributedConnectionMissingTable` | counter | Number | Number of times we rejected a replica from a distributed query, because it did not contain a table needed for the query. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DistributedConnectionStaleReplica` | counter | Number | Number of times we rejected a replica from a distributed query, because some table needed for a query had replication lag higher than the configured threshold. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DistributedConnectionFailAtAll` | counter | Number | Total count when distributed connection fails after all retries finished. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_HedgedRequestsChangeReplica` | counter | Number | Total count when timeout for changing replica expired in hedged requests. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_SuspendSendingQueryToShard` | counter | Number | Total count when sending query to shard was suspended when async_query_sending_for_remote is enabled. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_CompileFunction` | counter | Number | Number of times a compilation of generated LLVM code (to create fused function for complex expressions) was initiated. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_CompiledFunctionExecute` | counter | Number | Number of times a compiled function was executed. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_CompileExpressionsMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Total time spent for compilation of expressions to LLVM code. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_CompileExpressionsBytes` | counter | Number | Number of bytes used for expressions compilation. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExecuteShellCommand` | counter | Number | Number of shell command executions. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExternalProcessingCompressedBytesTotal` | counter | Number | Number of compressed bytes written by external processing (sorting/aggragating/joining) |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExternalProcessingUncompressedBytesTotal` | counter | Bytes | Amount of data (uncompressed, before compression) written by external processing (sorting/aggragating/joining) |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExternalProcessingFilesTotal` | counter | Number | Number of files used by external processing (sorting/aggragating/joining) |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExternalSortWritePart` | counter | Number | Number of times a temporary file was written to disk for sorting in external memory. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExternalSortMerge` | counter | Number | Number of times temporary files were merged for sorting in external memory. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExternalSortCompressedBytes` | counter | Number | Number of compressed bytes written for sorting in external memory. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExternalSortUncompressedBytes` | counter | Bytes | Amount of data (uncompressed, before compression) written for sorting in external memory. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExternalAggregationWritePart` | counter | Number | Number of times a temporary file was written to disk for aggregation in external memory. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExternalAggregationMerge` | counter | Number | Number of times temporary files were merged for aggregation in external memory. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExternalAggregationCompressedBytes` | counter | Number | Number of bytes written to disk for aggregation in external memory. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExternalAggregationUncompressedBytes` | counter | Bytes | Amount of data (uncompressed, before compression) written to disk for aggregation in external memory. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExternalJoinWritePart` | counter | Number | Number of times a temporary file was written to disk for JOIN in external memory. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExternalJoinMerge` | counter | Number | Number of times temporary files were merged for JOIN in external memory. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExternalJoinCompressedBytes` | counter | Number | Number of compressed bytes written for JOIN in external memory. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ExternalJoinUncompressedBytes` | counter | Bytes | Amount of data (uncompressed, before compression) written for JOIN in external memory. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_SlowRead` | counter | Number | Number of reads from a file that were slow. This indicate system overload. Thresholds are controlled by read_backoff_* settings. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ReadBackoff` | counter | Number | Number of times the number of query processing threads was lowered due to slow reads. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ReplicaPartialShutdown` | counter | Number | How many times Replicated table has to deinitialize its state due to session expiration in ZooKeeper. The state is reinitialized every time when ZooKeeper is available again. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_SelectedParts` | counter | Number | Number of data parts selected to read from a MergeTree table. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_SelectedRanges` | counter | Number | Number of (non-adjacent) ranges in all data parts selected to read from a MergeTree table. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_SelectedMarks` | counter | Number | Number of marks (index granules) selected to read from a MergeTree table. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_SelectedRows` | counter | Number | Number of rows SELECTed from all tables. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_SelectedBytes` | counter | Number | Number of bytes (uncompressed; for columns as they stored in memory) SELECTed from all tables. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_WaitMarksLoadMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Time spent loading marks |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_BackgroundLoadingMarksTasks` | counter | Number | Number of background tasks for loading marks |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_LoadedMarksCount` | counter | Number | Number of marks loaded (total across columns). |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_LoadedMarksMemoryBytes` | counter | Bytes | Size of in-memory representations of loaded marks. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_Merge` | counter | Number | Number of launched background merges. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_MergedRows` | counter | Number | Rows read for background merges. This is the number of rows before merge. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_MergedUncompressedBytes` | counter | Bytes | Uncompressed bytes (for columns as they stored in memory) that was read for background merges. This is the number before merge. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_MergesTimeMilliseconds` | counter | Milliseconds | Total time spent for background merges. |

| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_InsertedWideParts` | counter | Number | Number of parts inserted in Wide format. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_InsertedCompactParts` | counter | Number | Number of parts inserted in Compact format. |

| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_MergeTreeDataProjectionWriterRows` | counter | Number | Number of rows INSERTed to MergeTree tables projection. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_MergeTreeDataProjectionWriterUncompressedBytes` | counter | Bytes | Uncompressed bytes (for columns as they stored in memory) INSERTed to MergeTree tables projection. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_MergeTreeDataProjectionWriterCompressedBytes` | counter | Bytes | Bytes written to filesystem for data INSERTed to MergeTree tables projection. |

| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_MergeTreeDataProjectionWriterBlocksAlreadySorted` | counter | Number | Number of blocks INSERTed to MergeTree tables projection that appeared to be already sorted. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_CannotRemoveEphemeralNode` | counter | Number | Number of times an error happened while trying to remove ephemeral node. This is not an issue, because our implementation of ZooKeeper library guarantee that the session will expire and the node will be removed. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_RegexpCreated` | counter | Number | Compiled regular expressions. Identical regular expressions compiled just once and cached forever. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ContextLock` | counter | Number | Number of times the lock of Context was acquired or tried to acquire. This is global lock. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_ContextLockWaitMicroseconds` | counter | Microseconds | Context lock wait time in microseconds |

| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DataAfterMergeDiffersFromReplica` | counter | Number | Number of times data after merge is not byte-identical to the data on another replicas. There could be several reasons: 1. Using newer version of compression library after server update. 2. Using another compression method. 3. Non-deterministic compression algorithm (highly unlikely). 4. Non-deterministic merge algorithm due to logical error in code. 5. Data corruption in memory due to bug in code. 6. Data corruption in memory due to hardware issue. 7. Manual modification of source data after server startup. 8. Manual modification of checksums stored in ZooKeeper. 9. Part format related settings like 'enable_mixed_granularity_parts' are different on different replicas. The server successfully detected this situation and will download merged part from the replica to force the byte-identical result. |
| `ClickHouseProfileEvents_DataAfterMutationDiffersFromReplica` | counter | Number | Number of times data after mutation is not byte-identical to the data on other replicas. In addition to the reasons described in 'DataAfterMergeDiffersFromReplica', it is also possible due to non-deterministic mutation. |

High values indicate either that you forgot to turn off swap on your server, or eviction of memory pages of the ClickHouse binary during very high memory pressure, or successful usage of the 'mmap' read method for the tables data. |

| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_NetworkSendErrors_eth0` | gauge | Number | Number of times error (e.g. TCP retransmit) happened while sending via the network interface. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just clickhouse-server. |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_NetworkSendPackets_eth0` | gauge | Number | Number of network packets sent via the network interface. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just clickhouse-server. |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_NetworkSendBytes_eth0` | gauge | Number | Number of bytes sent via the network interface. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just clickhouse-server. |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_NetworkReceiveDrop_eth0` | gauge | Number | Number of bytes a packet was dropped while received via the network interface. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just clickhouse-server. |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_NetworkReceivePackets_eth0` | gauge | Number | Number of network packets received via the network interface. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just clickhouse-server. |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_BlockQueueTime_nvme0n1` | gauge | Number | This value counts the number of milliseconds that IO requests have waited on this block device. If there are multiple IO requests waiting, this value will increase as the product of the number of milliseconds times the number of requests waiting. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just clickhouse-server. Source: `/sys/block`. See https://www.kernel.org/doc/Documentation/block/stat.txt |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_DiskAvailable_default` | gauge | Bytes | Available bytes on the disk (virtual filesystem). Remote filesystems may not provide this information. |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_BlockActiveTime_nvme0n1` | gauge | Seconds | Time in seconds the block device had the IO requests queued. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just clickhouse-server. Source: `/sys/block`. See https://www.kernel.org/doc/Documentation/block/stat.txt |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_BlockInFlightOps_nvme0n1` | gauge | Number | This value counts the number of I/O requests that have been issued to the device driver but have not yet completed. It does not include IO requests that are in the queue but not yet issued to the device driver. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just clickhouse-server. Source: `/sys/block`. See https://www.kernel.org/doc/Documentation/block/stat.txt |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_BlockWriteTime_nvme0n1` | gauge | Seconds | Time in seconds spend in write operations requested from the block device, summed across all the operations. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just clickhouse-server. Source: `/sys/block`. See https://www.kernel.org/doc/Documentation/block/stat.txt |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_BlockWriteBytes_nvme0n1` | gauge | Number | Number of bytes written to the block device. It can be lower than the number of bytes written to the filesystem due to the usage of the OS page cache, that saves IO. A write to the block device may happen later than the corresponding write to the filesystem due to write-through caching. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just clickhouse-server. Source: `/sys/block`. See https://www.kernel.org/doc/Documentation/block/stat.txt |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_BlockWriteMerges_nvme0n1` | gauge | Number | Number of write operations requested from the block device and merged together by the OS IO scheduler. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just clickhouse-server. Source: `/sys/block`. See https://www.kernel.org/doc/Documentation/block/stat.txt |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_BlockDiscardOps_nvme0n1` | gauge | Number | Number of discard operations requested from the block device. These operations are relevant for SSD. Discard operations are not used by ClickHouse, but can be used by other processes on the system. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just clickhouse-server. Source: `/sys/block`. See https://www.kernel.org/doc/Documentation/block/stat.txt |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_BlockReadOps_nvme0n1` | gauge | Number | Number of read operations requested from the block device. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just clickhouse-server. Source: `/sys/block`. See https://www.kernel.org/doc/Documentation/block/stat.txt |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_Uptime` | gauge | Seconds | The server uptime in seconds. It includes the time spent for server initialization before accepting connections. |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_HashTableStatsCacheMisses` | gauge | Number | The number of times the prediction of a hash table size was incorrect. |
| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_BlockWriteTime_sdb` | gauge | Seconds | Time in seconds spend in write operations requested from the block device, summed across all the operations. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just clickhouse-server. Source: `/sys/block`. See https://www.kernel.org/doc/Documentation/block/stat.txt |

| `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_OSIrqTimeCPU15` | gauge | Fraction | The ratio of time spent for running hardware interrupt requests on the CPU.
